parameters.jsCode: const text=String($json.body?.message??$json.message??'').trim(); const emergency=/(chest pain|can't breathe|cannot breathe|difficulty breathing|severe bleeding|stroke|unconscious|overdose|suicid|kill myself|self[- ]harm)/i.test(text); return [{json:{...$json,message:text,emergency}}];

return [{json:{status:'emergency',action:'seek_immediate_emergency_help',message:'This may be an emergency. Call your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department. return [{json:{status:'allowed',mode:'information_only',message:$json.message,scope:['general health education','questions to discuss with a qualified clinician','care-navigation information'],disclaimer:'Information only.
